contentText: The UNHCR launched it's "Until Everyone is Safe" campaign. It's a call to young people across the world to reclaim and defend the fundamental human right of asylum as a shared global good. •The campaign challenges stereotypes against refugees, emphasizing that the right to seek safety is a crucial lifeline that means far more than the absence of war and violence. It encompasses the legal right to work, access health care, pursue an education, and live with dignity—the exact tools needed to move beyond survival and rebuild a future. FRANCE 24's Mark Owen speaks with Eujin Byun, Global Spokesperson for the UNHCR, the UN refugee agency.
